panels.title: ledger_integrity_check_drift_count — zero tolerance, P0 on any nonzero value
panels.description: Payments Service, LedgerIntegrityService/LedgerIntegrityJob (daily 02:00 UTC) — general double-entry check across ALL posted ledger transactions. See docs/runbook-ledger-integrity.md.

panels.title: susu_pot_integrity_drift_count — separate, narrower check (monolith)
panels.description: This is a DIFFERENT, additional integrity check — SusuPotIntegrityChecker/SusuPotIntegrityJob, lives in monolith (not payments-service), runs daily at 03:00 UTC, checks a single susu group's ledger-account balance against its expected contribution history. A clean panel above does NOT mean this one is also clean — both are zero-tolerance and both are alerted separately. Do not apply docs/runbook-ledger-integrity.md's "check the Payments Service is up" step to this metric — it's the wrong service.
